is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae and An. coluzzii) in Togo.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr L1014F) and Ace-1 G280S (ace1 G119S) in Table 2.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 provides genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) and frequencies for both markers across two collection methods.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in the field in Kolokopé, Togo (October 2017).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting new field data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study location is specified as Kolokopé, Plateau region, Togo.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper describes a specific, one-time collection in October 2017 for this study, distinct from previous surveillance mentioned in the references.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study characterizes the insecticide resistance profile and resistance mechanisms (kdr L1014F and ace1 G119S) of Anopheles gambiae s.l. in Kolokopé, Togo, using WHO susceptibility tests and PCR genotyping on field-collected mosquitoes.
